The Network Reader (ItemNetworkReader.useOn) clicked through ServerPlayerGameMode.useItemOn with a GameTestPlayer. case: scene/target/detail. face: the clicked face. sneak: the player sneaking. set: the values put by reflection in the same tick, right before the click (energy: stored and prev_transfer; fluid and chemical: resource, stored; heat: mean_temp, heat_lost, heat_transferred). raw: the numbers of the network the clicked block transmits for (family, transmitters, acceptors, stored, needed, capacity, prev_transfer or the heat fields; resource ids; longs as strings; doubles as Double.toString). result: InteractionResult of useItemOn. chat: the non overlay system messages the player received, ComponentSerialization.CODEC JSON, in order.
